status: Concept mockups only; no game/economy changes

sources.lesson: Visible numbered holes, tangible prizes and physical ball movement; proposed desktop adaptation is our inference.
Visible nail-and-ball play and retro mechanical machines; use visible physical targets.
Distinguish ball entry and triggered digital jackpot outcomes rather than equating every hit with a jackpot.
Marbles traverse mechanisms; jackpot falls from above. Inform a visible top treasury and reward cascade.
Collect seven apples for Wonder Chance, then Jackpot Chance; intermediate progress can be visible and persistent.
Fever items include extra ball, revival and opening jackpot pockets; special outcomes can change play rather than just payout.
Aim, fire and clear orange pegs; keep a clear ball-level target.
Triggers generate earnings, more balls and synergies; icon bumpers should have distinct visible effects.

initialPrompts.A:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high-fidelity QBot Windows desktop marble-game concept, landscape 16:9, 1920x1080 composition, edge-to-edge flat screenshot, no photographed monitor, no surrounding desk, no multi-panel sheet. A playable-looking desktop overlay concept, not a mobile app. Ordinary Windows taskbar clearly visible at bottom, recognizable existing desktop shortcut icons with tiny labels remain present, including Recycle Bin, folder, browser, Excel and game controller shortcut. Preserve the distinction between existing OS icons and temporarily glowing game rings around them. Realistic OS shell mixed with beautifully crafted soft toy-like game objects; warm cream, dark brown fine outlines and carefully restrained jewel-colored rewards. Crisp, legible, very sparse Simplified Chinese UI, short labels only; no instructions paragraphs or explanation annotations. Reference image is ONLY a character identity reference: the small black-haired chibi boy with blue hoodie and yellow chick, same silhouette and face; do not copy the reference white background or its bottom toolbar. Character appears once as the actual desktop pet, plus a tiny clearly separate collectible outfit preview if needed. Main rewards are in-game coins and avatar cosmetics, no real money symbols. Show a physical mound of gold coins labeled '10,000', a beautiful navy and violet constellation cape labeled '星旅披风' on a small clear display mannequin, and pink petal footprint cosmetic labeled '步生花'. The three rewards must be immediately visually recognizable at thumbnail size, not mystery boxes. Label their display '大奖池'. Actual playing field contains ordinary coin rewards, three star targets with two lit and one unlit, and a physically understandable golden entrance labeled '大奖挑战'. Do not imply mere entry guarantees the displayed jackpot. No probabilities invented. Show only one short trajectory segment or ball trail, not an infographic full of arrows. No casino red carpet, no slot reels, no wall of tiny currencies, no extra invented menu text. These are design mockups.
Variant A: DESKTOP PLAYGROUND / calm everyday mode. Soft sage hills and pale sky wallpaper. Most (about 65%) of wallpaper unobstructed. Left fifth has two normal columns of desktop icons, all in original evenly spaced OS grid. Four of these icons have thin luminous circular bumper rings; do not move the icons. A delicate transparent golden curved rail carries a silver-blue marble from top-left through the icon zone toward the lower central area. A few freestanding wind-chime and mushroom bumper toys supplement the sparse desktop, only 5 extra obstacles, ample negative space. Compact launcher near upper-left active field. A short chain of three star lantern targets in middle; 2 lit. Across lower middle directly above taskbar, a low cream collection tray with 4 clear apertures, showing coin stack '100', coin stack '300', small star shard, and the taller golden '大奖挑战' gateway. RIGHT FIFTH is a narrow floating warm cream prize showcase (no giant app window): its top shelf contains the largest coin pile '10,000', middle shelf holds an exquisite full-view cape on mannequin, bottom shelf a petal trail preview. Gold star emblem at header '大奖池'. The chibi pet stands at lower right just outside showcase with a catch basket, looking toward the marble. Tiny compact bottom-left capsule shows a marble icon '8' and one '发射' button. Minimal header top-left '桌面弹珠'. Physically coherent motion and visual hierarchy: ball and icons first, coin jackpot second, wearable cape third. Premium cozy desktop game art, natural soft daylight, image-rich rewards, no explanatory captions.

refinements.prompt: Edit this exact QBot desktop marble concept screenshot. Preserve the chibi boy and chick exactly, preserve right prize showcase, its three rewards, 10,000, bottom reward pockets, bottom left 8 and 发射, Windows taskbar, cozy landscape wallpaper and all short Chinese labels. Make the EXISTING DESKTOP ICONS unmistakably the main physical collision field. Remove BOTH long transparent curving rails that run across the central wallpaper. Replace the rail arrangement with a short readable dotted blue ricochet path that starts at the top launcher, hits the gold collision rim of the Google Chrome desktop shortcut in the left column, bounces to the Excel shortcut lower left, and then hits the game controller shortcut beside it, then ricochets down and right into the bottom collection tray. Place ONE small silver-blue ball touching the Chrome icon's outer collision rim with a tiny bright contact spark, showing an actual physical impact. The icon itself must remain its original size, appearance and original OS-grid location. Give only those three real desktop icons a solid clear soft-edged circular physical bumper ring with a subtle brass rim, each rim no more than 1.4 times icon width. NO copies of desktop icons in the central field. Remove the large central mushrooms and windmill, replace at most TWO with small auxiliary bumpers immediately to the right of icon grid (one at middle height one at lower height) to guide balls toward bottom tray. Preserve the three hanging star lamps but suspend from one thin almost invisible thread at mid-screen; 2 lit 1 unlit. This must feel like balls interact with the user's own computer icons and the open desktop, not ride an independent rollercoaster. Keep 60% or more central wallpaper as clear negative space. Do not add slogans, annotations, labels, extra text, decorative writing or any new controls. Remove visible taskbar date/time numerals, keep tiny normal system icons. Flat 16:9 desktop screenshot. All reward text stays accurate.

notes: Coin values 100, 300 and 10000 are visual placeholders, not balanced economic parameters.
A preserves original shortcut positions; B and C explore game copies in a curated layout.
Stars indicate entry into a challenge, not guaranteed receipt of the costume.
Star cape is a proposed cosmetic concept; these images are not evidence of implemented costume compatibility.
